turns.prompt: I have 7 kg cattle slurry and 3 kg poultry litter, but no ammonia, pH, TS, or VS tests. Assess the main risks, calculate only supported quantities, and prioritize the next lab measurements.
turns.answer: The provided data indicates that anaerobic digestion of cattle manure typically occurs under mesophilic conditions (around 35°C) and requires a digestion duration of approximately 30 to 65 days, depending on the co-substrates and operational parameters. For instance, studies show that co-digestion with food waste or grass can extend the digestion period to 65 days, while co-digestion with pig manure may shorten it to 30 days. These conditions are influenced by factors such as temperature, substrate composition, and inoculum quality. For optimal methane production, maintaining a stable mesophilic temperature and ensuring proper mixing and retention time are critical.
